name: A Little Knowledge
body:
Your mind is open to distant possibilities when you ponder bizarre magic.

Prerequisite(s): Use Magic Device 4+ ranks.

Benefit(s): Whenever you make a Use Magic Device checks to cast spells from a scroll or to emulate a class or alignment for a magic item, you can choose to add a +4 bonus to your roll. If you do, you take 1d4 points of Wisdom damage. You can only use this ability once per round as a free action after knowing your skill check total but before success or failure is confirmed.
